title: "Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
data("rest_inspec")
```

### Plots

```{r}
plot1 = rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    boro == "Manhattan",
    cuisine_description == "Pizza",
    !is.na(score),
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Restaurant: ", dba,
                            "\nScore: ", score,
                            "\nGrade: ", grade)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~inspection_date, y = ~score, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.75) |> 
  layout(
    title = "Manhattan Pizza Inspection Scores Over Time",
    xaxis = list(title = "Inspection date"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score (higher = more violations)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Grade"))
  )

plot1
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------



```{r}
top_cuisines = rest_inspec |>
  distinct(camis, cuisine_description) |>
  count(cuisine_description, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  pull(cuisine_description)

plot2 = rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    boro == "Queens",
    cuisine_description %in% top_cuisines,
    !is.na(score)
  ) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    cuisine_description = str_replace(cuisine_description, "Latin.*", "Latin"),
    cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, score)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~cuisine_description, y = ~score, color = ~cuisine_description,
    type = "box", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    title = "Inspection Scores for Top 10 Cuisines in Queens",
    margin = list(t = 60),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -45),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection score (higher = more violations)")
  )

plot2
```

-----------------------------------------------------------------------



```{r}
plot3 = rest_inspec |>
  filter(grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"), !boro %in% c("Missing", "0")) |> 
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  count(boro, grade) |>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~boro, y = ~n, color = ~grade, type = "bar", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    title = "Restaurant Grades by Borough",
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of inspections"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Grade"), orientation = "h", y = 1.05)
  )

plot3
```
